# Josh Driver

> Josh Driver (Joshua Driver) is an Indianapolis keynote speaker and the founder
> and CEO of Selflessly, a workplace giving and volunteering platform. He speaks
> on practical AI in small companies, employee giving programs and civic tech,
> and offers executive mentorship, startup consulting and AI consulting.

## Who he is

- Name: Joshua Driver (goes by Josh Driver)
- Role: Founder and CEO of Selflessly (https://selflessly.io)
- Location: Indianapolis, Indiana, USA
- Recognition: IBJ 40 Under 40; TechPoint Mira Award, Community Champion of the Year
- Featured: Indianapolis Business Journal, "Founder rebuilds software platform
  with AI agent at the core"
  (https://www.ibj.com/articles/founder-rebuilds-software-platform-with-ai-agent-at-the-core);
  CICP Indiana AI case study (https://www.cicpindiana.com/ai-use-cases-selflessly/)
- Background: former Director at NIC Inc (in.gov, Indiana Management Performance
  Hub, Know the O Facts); former paramedic at Wishard Hospital; created Open for
  Service (CNN and BBC coverage); Indianapolis Equal Opportunity Advisory Board.

## Speaking topics

1. I Rebuilt My Company Around an AI Agent: What Actually Works
2. AI for the Rest of Us: Small Teams, Real Guardrails
3. Giving That Sticks: Employee Giving Programs People Actually Use
4. Government That Works Like an App: Lessons From Civic Tech
5. ADHD, AI, and the Art of Staying Out of Your Own Way

Formats: keynote, panel, fireside chat, workshop, lunch and learn. In person or
virtual. Based in Indianapolis, available nationwide.

## Consulting and mentorship

Executive mentorship, startup consulting, AI consulting, technology strategy,
fractional leadership, B Corp and benefit corporation guidance.
